InformationInFigures: Yes. Porosity of (as-sprayed?) deposits in Fig. 8. Yield strength, UTS, and %EL in Fig. 18 (nitrogen only), He UTS and %EL (Fig. 19).

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical, with a few satellite particles. surface of GRCop-42 powder particles have a segregated microstructure along with fissures and cracks, cracks also found in cross section of particle. surface of HR-1 appears more homogenous, visible dendrite arms on surface.

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: VRC Gen III / 21 kW high-pressure cold spray system
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: GRCop-42 specimens were etched using a solution of 12.5 ml Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH), 25 ml Ammonium Persulfate ((NH4)2S2O8), and 12.5 ml distilled water. HR-1 specimens were electrochemically etched in 10% oxalic acid at 10 V for 5 s.  Tensile samples were extracted from the cold spray deposits using a water jet cutting process with the specimen dimensions shown in Fig. 2. The tensile specimens were polished to 600 grit to reduce the roughness and remove any scratches from the surface.
